The multi-Oscar-winning creative Film & Episodic Studio at Framestore has worked with some of the greatest storytellers in film today. Collaborating with directors and producers across the complete filmmaking process to help design, plan and create beautiful images, we focus on finding innovative creative solutions to support their vision and set new standards for visual effects in cinema.
 Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.
 About the role 
 This is an existing role within our team for a versatile, creatively curious artist who loves solving complex visual puzzles across the full 3D pipeline. As part of our Visual Development team, you’ll bridge the gap between initial concepting and final VFX execution.
 Blender is central to how our VisDev team designs and crafts key sequences early in production - extensively powering our work on shows like IF , Loki S2 , and How To Train Your Dragon, to name only a few.
 With Blender as your primary tool, you’ll move fluidly between modelling, look development, lighting and rendering - equally comfortable turning your hand to creatures, environments and FX - to define visual benchmarks and answer creative and technical questions early across a wide range of subject matter.
 What you’ll do: 
 Develop high-end, photorealistic visual development assets across a broad range of subject matter - from creatures and characters to full environments and complex FX - taking designs from blockout through to finished frame.
 Sculpt and detail creatures, build and dress environments, and art-direct FX moments (destruction, fluids, smoke, particles) to establish look, scale and mood early.
 Work end-to-end in Blender - modelling, sculpting, shading and texturing, lighting and rendering - picking up whichever part of the pipeline a given problem needs.
 Build look development and lighting setups that hold up to photoreal scrutiny, and create shaders and materials using Blender’s node system.
 Use procedural and node-based workflows, such as Geometry Nodes and simulation, to explore and iterate on environments and FX at pace.
 Collaborate with supervisors and the HOD to ensure your work supports a smooth transition into 2D/3D production, handing off clean, well-structured scenes.
 Communicate your creative process clearly, breaking down complex technical workflows for both artists and stakeholders, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and process sharing.
 What we’re looking for: 
 Extensive Blender experience across the full generalist pipeline - modelling, sculpting, UVs, shading/texturing, lighting and rendering.
 A visual background with a strong portfolio in frame and shot composition.
 Solid experience in film VFX 3D processes and a good grasp of cinematography in virtual environments.
 Confidence in building look development and lighting that stands up to photoreal scrutiny, including shader/material creation in Blender’s node system.
 A proactive approach to identifying and resolving visual issues while maintaining quality and logic.
 The ability to take direction well while maintaining organised scenes, .blend files, node setups, and documents.
 You might also have 
 Geometry Nodes and other procedural or node-based workflows (and comfort scripting small tools where useful).
 Working knowledge of complementary DCCs (e.g. Maya, Houdini, ZBrush, Substance, Nuke).
 Experience with Digital Matte Painting, or simulation and FX work (cloth, fluids, particles, hair/fur).
 Familiarity with Texture packages like Mari and a working knowledge of practical cameras, lighting, or physics.
 Accessibility Statement 
 Our Montreal studio has universal access, with step-free entry, accessible toilets, and quiet spaces available. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace for everyone and continue to improve accessibility to ensure all employees feel supported.
 Application Process & Deadline 
 To apply, please complete the linked application form or email your resume and portfolio to recruiters@framestore.com with the subject line: Film Blender Generalist - Montreal 
 We review all applications manually and do not use artificial intelligence to screen candidates. If you require any adjustments or support during the application process, please let us know—we’re happy to help.

About Novacom
 Novacom is a Surrey-based General Contractor specializing in commercial Tenant Improvement (TI) construction for financial institutions, restaurants, offices, and retail spaces across BC. We value people, relationships, innovation, and culture and we’re committed to doing construction differently by continually improving how we work, build, and collaborate. We believe in partnership and 80% of our work is repeat clients.
 The Role
 We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our growing team. This role focuses on TI projects ranging from $2M–$10M and involves managing projects from startup through closeout while working closely with site teams, clients, consultants, and subtrades. We’re looking for a Project Manager who is already running their own work and wants a bigger projects, a real support team around them, and a company that will invest in taking them further. 
 What You'd Run: 
 Your own portfolio of commercial TI projects, from buyout through closeout, with a dedicated Project Coordinator and Site Superintendent on your team.
 You report to a Project Director whose job is to coach you through the parts that take time to build: the monthly Procore reconciliation, pushing a schedule when it starts to slip, running a tight OAC meeting, and reading how each client wants to be communicated with. You do the work. They make sure you have the support you need.
 Project startup: buyout, subcontracts, insurance, Procore setup, kick-off meetings
 Monthly progress draws and budget reconciliation in Procore. You draft it, your PD reviews it before it finalizes.
 Schedule: built with your superintendent, held with your trades
 Change orders, RFIs and submittals kept moving, not piled up for closeout
 OAC progress meetings: your agenda, your meeting
 Closeout: binder, permits, deficiencies, holdback conversations
 Our Technology stack: Procore, Acumatica, Smartsheet, Outbuild, BuildingConnected, HH2 and Microsoft 365.
 What We Need to See: 
 3+ years in commercial construction, including projects you have run yourself from buyout through closeout as the lead PM. What your title said matters less than whether you carried the job
 Solid Procore Experience: budget, commitments, RFIs, submittals, change events
 Construction admin foundations: schedule of values, progress draws, holdbacks, the change order cycle
 Comfortable in front of a client, responsive and you don’t leave emails sitting
 You work office-based with a superintendent running the field. This is not a PM/superintendent hybrid role
 Post-secondary or technical education in construction management or a related field
 What We’re Looking for 
 You tell clients the truth about the schedule, early. We would rather have a hard conversation in week six than a surprise in week twenty
 You chase the schedule instead of reporting on it. When a trade starts to slip you are on it that week, not at the next OAC
 You notice when a number moves. Your PD reviews the monthly reconciliation with you, but the habit we’re looking for is you catching the variance first
 Closeout isn’t a scramble for you. Binders, permits and deficiencies get worked the whole way through rather than left to the end
 You want to be coached. You’ll have a Project Director who reviews your numbers and pushes on your schedule. The people who do best here treat that as the point, not a nuisance
 Trades and superintendents are partners, not resources. We hire humble, generous people and it shows on our sites
 What We Offer

 Annual Bonus against a clear scorecard, so you’ll know exactly what you’re measured on
 RRSP matching and profit sharing. Everyone here shares in company profitabilit
 Hybrid: Monday-Thursday in the Surrey office; Friday on your sites or from home
 Tools to do the job properly. Procore, Acumatica, Outbuild, BuildingConnected and Microsoft 365. You won’t be running a project out of a spreadsheet
 Defined career path. We’ll show you how you move through the levels of the role and what’s expected at each one, and we help coach you along the way and cover the training costs to get you there. 
 Close-knit team. A flat structure, regular one-to-ones with your manager, staff lunches and an annual retreat. Small enough that you’re known, supported and pushed to grow
 Giving back. We put real time into the industry we work in and the communities around it.  The Opportunity: 
 We’re looking to fill an opening for a Senior Manager, Sales Enablement & Operations to join our Strategic Partnerships and Priority Clients team. 
 Reporting to the VP, Strategic Partnerships and Priority Clients, the Senior Manager, Sales Enablement & Operations is accountable for enabling the Direct Investing sales organization to consistently deliver against plan by aligning targets, activity, pipeline execution, skills, processes, and technology.

 Lead the monthly and quarterly Direct Investing sales reporting cycle, ensuring timely, accurate, and executive-ready reporting on sales performance, pipeline health, target achievement, incentive progress, risks, and opportunities
 Establish and lead monthly business reviews with the leadership team, translating performance data into clear insights, decisions, actions, and follow-up accountability

 Manage, coach, and develop direct report(s), with the potential to expand people leadership responsibilities such as the sales strategy and operations function scales

 Represent Sales in enterprise initiatives, workshops, pilots, and cross-functional programs, consolidating feedback, shaping recommendations, and ensuring sales priorities are appropriately considered in business decisions

 Champion change management for new sales processes, tools, governance routines, and ways of working, driving adoption and sustained behavioural change across teams
 Requirements

 7-10 years of progressive experience in sales strategy, sales operations, revenue operations, sales enablement, or sales performance leadership roles
